findings.summary: Defect 6 residual consume: supervise/harvest_ops.py `_terminal_of` still reads status.json's terminal as a last-resort fallback when result.json has no terminal. It is authority-first (result.json) and documented as a rebuildable cache, and the two read sides the defect named (scheduler/wake.py, state/fleet_state.py) are converted and pinned red at source level; this fallback is the pre-existing H-B occupancy guard outside the six named deliverables, but it remains a machine read of the cache file.

Defect 4/5 refusal-vocabulary tests call the deliver_decision core directly rather than the @mcp.tool face; the MCP-entry requirement is satisfied for both blocker red targets (①②) which go through the registered decision_deliver tool via FastMCP in-process client, and defects 3-6 are spec'd as mechanical assertions.
Sealed verification records make verify as 2691/2692 passed with 0 failed and exit 0; the single non-pass is not classified (presumed skip) and could not be rerun in this read-only review.
